caseNameFull: Anheuser-Busch, Inc. v. Becker, Collector of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Messrs. Daniel N. Kirby and Harry W. Kroeger for petitioners. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Miss Helen B. Carloss and Mr. Paul R. Russell for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
